title: Self-supervised In-context Operator Learning for Stochastic Mean-Field Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.18282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic mean-field control (MFC) provides a fundamental framework for coordinating large populations of interacting agents under uncertainty, with a wide range of applications. Existing numerical and deep-learning methods solve one MFC problem instance at a time and must be re-optimized whenever the task changes. In this work, we formulate stochastic MFC as an operator-learning problem and develop, to the best of our knowledge, the first mesh-free, self-supervised neural operator for stochastic MFC. The main challenge is that the diffusion term in the controlled Fokker--Planck equation precludes deterministic transport-map representations. translated_title: 自监督上下文算子学习用于随机平均场控制
translated_abstract: 随机平均场控制（MFC）为在大规模交互智能体群体在不确定性下协调提供了一个基础框架，具有广泛的应用。现有的数值和深度学习方法一次只解决一个MFC问题实例，并且每当任务变化时必须重新优化。在本工作中，我们将随机MFC形式化为一个算子学习问题，并据我们所知，开发了首个无网格、自监督的神经算子用于随机MFC。主要挑战在于受控Fokker-Planck方程中的扩散项排除了确定性传输映射表示。我们通过结合概率流常微分方程与基于可逆归一化流的变换器来解决这一挑战，该变换器将动力学重新表述为确定性连续性方程，并通过精确逆和归一化流的解析对数行列式实现闭式得分评估。
tldr: 本文首次提出了一种无网格、自监督的神经算子方法，通过结合概率流ODE和可逆归一化流变换器，解决了随机平均场控制中的扩散项难题，实现了任务变化时无需重新优化的高效算子学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first mesh-free, self-supervised neural operator for stochastic mean-field control, addressing the diffusion-term challenge by combining probability-flow ODE with invertible normalizing-flow-based transformer, enabling task-agnostic operator learning without re-optimization.
